packageRules.description: backend/go.mod and backend/Dockerfile declare one Go toolchain version; CI and the container build fail when the two update separately
Renovate treats the go.mod go directive as a minimum version and does not bump it by default. Enable bumps so pull requests update it to the latest Go release.

By default Renovate only runs `go get`, which can leave go.sum without full-content checksums for shared transitive deps needed by go.mod `tool` directives (broke CI on the pdfcpu v0.14.0 PR). Run `go mod tidy` so non-major gomod PRs ship a consistent module graph (Renovate skips tidy on major updates unless gomodUpdateImportPaths is also enabled).
